lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Horizontal rows of high-luminance circular spots are visible along the lateral flanks, with a mean inter-spot distance of approximately two spot-diameters in the mid-body region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of subtly higher pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of spots to form a characteristic grid pattern across the mid-to-posterior flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the dorsal surface, each defined by a high-intensity highlight on the upper edge and a corresponding shadow gradient on the lower edge, following a linear path toward the caudal section.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin surface is populated with a high density of small, high-luminance blobs, with a notable clustering observed along the trailing posterior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A remora (Echeneidae) is attached to the distal margin of the left pectoral fin.
